record.question: The average age of 7 boys is 15 years. Another boy joins them and the average age becomes 14 years. Find the age of the new boy who joined.
record.explanation: The seven boys total 7×15=105 years. After one joins, eight boys total 8×14=112 years. The new boy is 112−105=7 years old, option B. Verified worked solution; unofficial.
